# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [Brent jumps 3.5% as the Houthis claim a strike on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 26, 2026. Ras Tanura, Saudi Arabia's largest refinery, is a target again. The Houthis claimed a strike there on Wednesday, Saudi air defenses said they downed four drones, and Brent settled up 3.5% at $94.61.
- [Upstream: US-led consortium agrees to buy Lukoil's international business](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Upstream: Iraq disputes the capacity number behind its 2027 OPEC+ quota](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Gas and LNG: Winter's first storage draw comes in at 24 Bcf](https://uticamidstream.com/#storage)
- [Downstream: US refiners run at 97.5% as fuel stocks build](https://uticamidstream.com/#refining)
- [Regulation: Texas Railroad Commission investigates Atmos Energy's pipe safety program](https://uticamidstream.com/#atmos)
- [Gas and LNG: Argentina LNG clears the RIGI incentive regime at $50.75 billion](https://uticamidstream.com/#argentina)
